headline.text: L3 posted *6 resolved issues* across ML4 and truffle line, but has broken bars at TG5 discharge and an air pressure fault still being worked.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran all three Sollich lines through the weekend. Both boilers were mistakenly drained overnight causing a 4-hour hot water outage from 04:00 to ~08:00, leaving some cleaning incomplete for Monday. S3 and S4 had brief equipment issues that cleared same-shift.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 had a productive night across ML2, ML3, and FFS. ML2 replaced a twin belt (26 minutes down) and has a butterfly valve that needs repair Monday. FFS changeover to 5.1oz was incomplete and will finish over the weekend.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 truffle line stopped 35 minutes at 02:20 for cavana and chocolate bin accumulation, cleared by 02:55. ML4 TG5 had a gondola crash at 11:40 causing broken bars; line restarted at 11:55 but broken-bar monitoring continues. TG5 air pressure fault at 07:56 has no posted resolution. MF Matrix had a late start on 2nd shift due to tray shortage.

notes.text: Boiler inspection scheduled Monday afternoon; only boiler 2 should be offline.
Francisco reports 400 lbs Celtic salt on hand (300 received yesterday plus 100 existing).
Fredy flagged pallet R474377 consumed by 3rd shift but not loaded into system, causing inventory discrepancies.

resolved.title: S4 enrober cable broken
resolved.summary: Cable for S4 enrober frayed and broke during 2nd shift.

resolved.title: Hot water outage from both boilers drained
resolved.summary: Both boilers mistakenly drained overnight instead of only one; plant out of hot water from 04:00 until ~08:00.
resolved.resolution: Boilers refilled and hot water restored by mid-morning; one boiler back online — "We will have 1 boiler so we will have hot water" (Curt Willis 09:28:28).

resolved.title: S3 checkweigher rejecting jars incorrectly
resolved.summary: Checkweigher reading ±2g after calibration; reports of CW working incorrectly even after calibration.
resolved.resolution: Calibration completed and significant reduction in rejected jars observed — "After the calibration we've seen a significant reduction in rejected jars" (Conner Boyd 18:21:59).

resolved.title: S4 mixing tank stirring slowly
resolved.summary: Mixing tank at 40 hz not blending ingredients as fast as previous day; sugar clumping and not mixing evenly.
resolved.resolution: Mixer rinsed and filter checked at 19:51; stirring much better — "They've rinsed the mixer, and now it's stirring much better" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: S3 labeler roller 9 gummed up
resolved.summary: Roller 9 gummed up causing labeler issues and accumulation.
resolved.resolution: Paused 15 minutes to pass accumulation and clean roller; labeler running great again — "Roller 9 was gummed up, the labeler is now running great again" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: ML2 twin belt issue
resolved.summary: One of the twin belts had problems causing line down at 15:56.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and line running again at 16:22 — "Line running again" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 brief line stoppage at 18:42
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 18:42 for unspecified reason.
resolved.resolution: Line back running at 18:46 — "Line running again" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: Truffle line cavana and chocolate bin accumulation
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 02:20 with 34 bins of chocolate accumulated and no extra bins available; accumulation passed during pause.
resolved.resolution: Line restarted at 02:55 after passing accumulation — "Line started back up at 2:55" (TruffleLine Enrober).

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 chocolate jam at gondola infeed
resolved.summary: TG5 threw code and stopped at 03:53; chocolate jam found at gondola infeed.
resolved.resolution: Jam cleared and line back up at 04:04 — "Line is back up" (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola crash throwing bars to floor
resolved.summary: Gondola exit belt stopped moving at 11:40, bars piled up and fell to floor; dirty rollers found on exit belt to TG4.
resolved.resolution: Exit belt cleaned and line back running at 11:55 — "Running" (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: MF Matrix pause for box shortage
resolved.summary: Line paused at 15:11 due to lack of corrugate boxes.
resolved.resolution: Boxes arrived and line restarted at 15:26 — restart visible in production log.

resolved.title: ML4 upside-down mold in heating cabinet
resolved.summary: Mold found upside down in heating cabinet blocking flow.
resolved.resolution: Mold cleared and line started — "Upside down Mold in heating cabinet. Mold cleared and Line started" (ML4 TG).

needs_attention.title: S2 bins and trays cleaning incomplete
needs_attention.summary: Unable to finish all bins and trays for Sol2 due to hot water outage from 04:00 onwards.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning incomplete as of 07:23; will need to be finished Monday.

needs_attention.title: S3 matrix cleaning incomplete
needs_attention.summary: MM3, MM4, MM5 clean but not assembled; parts wrapped in totes due to hot water outage.
needs_attention.status: Parts clean but need assembly Monday; wrapped and stored in totes as of 08:03.

needs_attention.title: ML2 butterfly valve rounded out
needs_attention.summary: Butterfly valve shaft square and good but valve part rounded out; valve will not turn.
needs_attention.status: Valve identified as needing replacement at 00:59; no repair action posted.

needs_attention.title: FFS changeover to 5.1oz incomplete
needs_attention.summary: Changeover to 5.1oz not complete; will need to be done over the weekend or Monday morning.
needs_attention.status: Changeover incomplete as of 06:29; scheduled to finish over weekend or Monday morning.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 no air pressure
needs_attention.summary: TG5 has no air pressure, maintenance working on it as of 07:56.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance working on air pressure issue as of 07:56; no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix no trays to start BEQ 2nd shift
needs_attention.summary: No trays available to start BEQ on 2nd shift; late start to catch up on making trays.
needs_attention.status: Late start on 2nd shift to make trays; no update on when production resumed.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M5 motor leaking
needs_attention.summary: M5 motor leaking, maintenance has been called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 00:56; no resolution posted as of window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG5 broken bars at gondola discharge
needs_attention.summary: After gondola crash and restart at 11:55, broken bars appearing at exit; EE posted to monitor and remove broken bars while root cause investigated.
needs_attention.status: EE monitoring discharge and removing broken bars as of 12:28; Preston asked to continue monitoring until end of run at 12:50.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line pallet not loaded into system
needs_attention.summary: Pallet R474377 consumed by 3rd shift but not loaded into system, causing inventory discrepancies.
needs_attention.status: Fredy flagged to leads at 10:42 requesting staff be reminded of labeling importance due to many inventory discrepancies.
